video.title: Southborough Special Open School Committee June 4, 2026

summary.headline: The Southborough School Committee unanimously voted to appoint Daniel Mazur as the new director of student support services for Southborough K-8.
summary.summary: In a brief special meeting, the Southborough School Committee voted unanimously to appoint Daniel Mazur as the district director of student support services for grades K-8 following a recommendation from the superintendent. Mazur previously served as assistant director of special education in the Acton-Boxborough Regional School District and earlier worked at Hopkinton Middle School and the New England Center for Children. The superintendent will now negotiate an employment contract, targeting a start date around July 1, 2024.

topics.title: Appointment of director of student support services
topics.summary: Superintendent Gregory Martineau recommended the appointment of Daniel Mazur as the Southborough K-8 director of student support services. The committee voted unanimously in favor of the appointment following a multi-district search process.
key_details: Daniel Mazur currently serves as assistant director of special education for the Acton-Boxborough Regional School District.
Mazur previously served as a special education team chair at Hopkinton Middle School and began his career at the New England Center for Children in Southborough.
School committee members met Mazur for questions during a screening session earlier in the week.
The superintendent and Mazur will negotiate a contract with a targeted start date around July 1, 2024, coordinating transition timing with Acton-Boxborough.
Southborough K-8 Extended School Year summer programming begins the Monday after the Fourth of July.
topics.why_it_matters: The director of student support services oversees special education and related student support programming for all Southborough public elementary and middle school students.
